title: Keep answered questions with their tracker

intentCoverage.report:
**Caught.**

Story: `SEED-073#keep-answered-questions-with-their-tracker`, checked revision `c763797a3cb3449d628cf57788221b37d66faeec` (2026-11-14). The source promises that an answered prompt and its question last as long as their tracker, and explicitly permits several prompts on that same tracker to share a question. This check covers unanswered-sibling cleanup; it does not independently probe tracker movement or the entire story.

One scratch fault removed only the `AND NOT EXISTS` surviving-prompt predicate from `McqRepository.deleteUnreferencedByIds` (`backend/src/main/java/com/odde/donut/entities/repositories/McqRepository.java:14`). The maintained fixtures and assertions stayed byte-identical. The same full command ran three times because backend guidance requires the complete suite:

```sh
CURSOR_DEV=true nix develop -c pnpm backend:test_only
```

| Run | Native / exit | Fresh JUnit result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Baseline | 11085 / 0 | 3,199 tests, 0 failures/errors, 2 opt-in skips |
| Fault | 75031 / 1 | 3,199 tests, 1 failure, 0 errors, 2 opt-in skips |
| Restored | 36470 / 0 | 3,199 tests, 0 failures/errors, 2 opt-in skips |

Each run includes the unchanged 3,198 maintained tests and one temporary independent SQL witness. The maintained catch was `MemoryTrackerQuestionDeletionControllerTest.preservesASharedQuestionUntilItsFinalOwningPromptEnds`, line100: the reloaded shared MCQ was `null`, failing `notNullValue()` after real `controller.deleteUnansweredRecallPrompts`.

The separate scratch witness used MakeMe-owned answered/shared/unanswered prompts on one tracker, plus conversation/message/correction dependents, and invoked the same real controller. Fresh SQL observations establish the wrong behavior rather than merely showing fault reach:

| State | Shared question | Answered prompt | Answer | Recall log | Prompt question binding |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Baseline | 1 row | 1 row | 1 row | 1 row | Original question7608 |
| Fault | 0 rows | 0 rows | 1 row | 1 row | NULL |
| Restored | 1 row | 1 row | 1 row | 1 row | Original question17 |

Existing migration325 makes question-to-prompt deletion CASCADE. Thus the fault deletes the answered prompt as well as its question while answer/log evidence survives. The independently observed loss matches the maintained assertion failure; the scratch witness itself added no maintained protection.

An EXIT/INT/TERM restoration trap restored the repository source before the third run. Original repository and maintained-test SHA256 values matched, the same restored command passed, then the temporary witness was removed and Git matched the original clean pre-probe state. The isolated database `doughnut_wt_0e9438f6804042a59953e56448c3ef4d_test` was retired through `pnpm worktree:retire` after its idle check; the owned scratch worktree and branch were safely removed. Parent product/test hashes remain unchanged. All owned native commands are terminal; no fault, test repair or product change was published.

**Next proof action:** retain the existing shared-question lifetime assertion. This probe supplies no new test-repair or follow-up decision; broader Intent Coverage and routing remain the caller's responsibility.

Evidence: `/tmp/donut-intent-c763-proof/` contains the one-line fault diff, exact source backups, phase logs, all643 XML files per run, three summaries, restoration and cleanup receipts, and the temporary witness source. The eventual report is retained there as `final-report.md`.

Costs:

- **Test runtime.** Measured JUnit maintained-case times were24ms /11ms /251ms (baseline/fault/restored); the independent witness was15ms /16ms /16ms. Runner-reported Gradle test-build phases were88s /80s /86s, including compilation. Their preceding migration phases were22s /15s /16s. Full-suite XML suite-time sums were75.896s /68.234s /71.239s; these are aggregate suite durations, not invocation wall time.
- **Human effort.** Zero developer interventions were requested or observed during the probe (measured interaction count). Human time is unavailable because no separate time measurement exists.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable as a measured effort figure: this interface exposes no independent agent CPU/token accounting. Observed work comprised three full backend checks, scratch setup/witness/inspection/cleanup, and one read-only helper audit of the witness/FK interpretation; no second probe ran. Invocation elapsed is measured separately below.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 741688 ms (measured), from 1794617579973 to 1794618321661 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.


## Wrap-up disposition

Checked revision: `c763797a3cb3449d628cf57788221b37d66faeec`.

Accepted **Caught** for same-tracker shared-question lifetime during unanswered-sibling cleanup. The independently observed SQL loss and the unchanged maintained assertion at MemoryTrackerQuestionDeletionControllerTest:100 agree. Baseline and restored full runs passed; exact source/test hashes, clean scratch state and owned resource retirement were verified. Current product/test bytes still match that checked revision; only documentation and closure records change afterward. This one probe does not establish coverage of tracker movement or the entire story.

Decision: retain the existing assertion; no test repair or new follow-up is supported. The deliberate fault is not a delivered defect. Product/proof retrospective required no correction plan and advised no product change, so no follow-up queue entry is added.
